machineVercel.description: Files persist across runs. Stopping ends running processes and clears their memory.
machineVercel.timeoutDescription: Defaults to 5 minutes. Maximum: 45 minutes on Hobby; 24 hours on Pro and Enterprise. Happier does not extend runs automatically.
machineVercel.retentionDescription: Use 0 for no expiry. Retained snapshots are billed after the sandbox stops.
machineVercel.checkUnavailable: Vercel account unavailable. Check the token, team, and project.
machineVercel.confirmBody: Vercel bills running compute and retained snapshots. Files can persist across runs; process memory cannot.
machineVercel.deleteBody: Deletes this sandbox and its owned snapshots. Its files cannot be recovered after deletion.
